issues.reason: Elemental Resistance (six element choices) and Breath Weapon shape (cone/line) are both mandatory; current wizard lacks race-specific choice storage, so default Syricta build is save-blocked.
Fly 40 ft (poor) and land 20 ft are separate; flight needs space for wing extension, land speed unaffected by armor/encumbrance.
Dragon Type modifies creature type and three standard traits; not safe to apply until verified.
Evasive Maneuvers describes base flight as 'clumsy' but the standard speed trait says 'poor'; source conflict requires review.
Memories of the Forgotten replaces ONLY the fly speed portion of Base Speed, and requires picking two Knowledge skills; not implemented.
Neglected Heritage removes only Draconic, not Common or all bonus language options; partial language replacement unresolved.
Wing-Clipped changes fly speed/maneuverability and cancels -2 DEX racial penalty, not the whole racial ability vector; unresolved.
Breath Weapon damage progression and 3/day uses require manual tracking.
Monstrous race category exceeds 15 RP and may require GM approval.

features.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
features.description: +2 STR, -2 DEX, +2 CHA

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium; global size effects are applied only once.

features.name: Type
features.description: humanoid (reptilian).

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 20 ft land and 40 ft fly (poor maneuverability).

features.name: Languages
features.description: Begins speaking Common and Draconic. Additional languages: Dwarvish, Elemental, Elvaan, Infernal, Kobold, Minotaur, Undercommon.

features.name: Dragonhide
features.description: +2 natural armor AC.

features.name: Dragon Resistances
features.description: +2 saves against paralysis and sleep only.

features.name: Elemental Resistance
features.description: Choose exactly one earth/fire/ice/lightning/water/wind at creation; resistance 5 to chosen element.

features.name: Draconic Presence
features.description: +2 Intimidate and Diplomacy; Fly is a class skill.

features.name: Gliding Wings
features.description: No falling damage, as from nonmagical choco feather.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Bite 1d6, primary or secondary while wielding manufactured weapons.

features.name: Breath Weapon
features.description: 3/day. Choose a 15-foot cone or 20-foot line at creation; damage 1d6 + 1d6 per two character levels, same element as Elemental Resistance; Reflex DC 10 + half class level + CON modifier.

features.name: Claws
features.description: Natural claw attacks 1d4 each.

features.name: Slapping Tail
features.description: Tail attack of opportunity, 1d8 + STR, 5-foot reach.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Darkvision 60 feet.

features.name: Low-Light Vision
features.description: See twice as far in dim light.

features.name: Dragon Type
features.description: Creature type becomes Dragon; sleep and paralysis immunity; loses elemental resistance, dragon resistances, breath. Requires cross-trait type replacement.

features.name: Evasive Maneuvers
features.description: Fly maneuverability average, +2 dodge AC and Reflex against siege weapons. Detailed source says clumsy standard flight but base says poor.

features.name: Greed
features.description: +2 Appraise, Appraise is class skill; +2 Sleight of Hand only for stealing things.

features.name: Memories of the Forgotten
features.description: +2 bonuses and class skills for TWO chosen Knowledge specializations; removes only flight, not land movement. Needs partial speed mapping and skill picker.

features.name: Neglected Heritage
features.description: Remove Draconic from starting languages, retain Common. Draconic unavailable as bonus language, but learnable via Linguistics; +1 conditional Diplomacy.

features.name: Oppressive
features.description: Swift Sense Motive contested versus target HD/CHA or Bluff; on success +4 Intimidate vs target and +1 DC fear effects against target.

features.name: Weather Savvy
features.description: Full-round action accurately forecast 24-hour natural weather, not magic weather.

features.name: Wing-Clipped
features.description: Fly 20 feet (clumsy) with DC30 Fly to ascend, +2 Bluff/Climb/Diplomacy, and removes normal -2 DEX racial modifier. Requires partial speed/score replacement.

choicePools.name: Elemental Resistance selection
choicePools.notes: Required choice at character creation. Existing wizard cannot persist race-specific selections; do not invent a default.

choicePools.name: Breath Weapon selection
choicePools.notes: Required choice at character creation. Existing wizard cannot persist race-specific selections; do not invent a default.

alternateReplacements.description: Dragon Type replaces or modifies Type, Elemental Resistance, Dragon Resistances, Breath Weapon; partial or source-conflicted mapping needs review.
Evasive Maneuvers replaces or modifies Darkvision, Dragon Resistances; partial or source-conflicted mapping needs review.
Greed replaces or modifies Draconic Presence.
Memories of the Forgotten replaces or modifies Base Speed; partial or source-conflicted mapping needs review.
Neglected Heritage replaces or modifies Languages; partial or source-conflicted mapping needs review.
Oppressive replaces or modifies Draconic Presence.
Weather Savvy replaces or modifies Draconic Presence.
Wing-Clipped replaces or modifies Base Speed, Ability Score Racial Traits; partial or source-conflicted mapping needs review.
